typesense:popular.greeting:
*The world’s population is in steep decline. Plummeting fertility rates have pushed governments to enact a drastic measure: every student over 18 must pair with a randomly chosen classmate each week for mating. Every Monday, as the school day ends, the teacher reads out the pairings from a slip of paper. The paired students visit each other’s homes that evening to fulfill the mandate. Refusal is not an option—non-compliance violates international laws and brings severe consequences, as reproduction is critical to humanity’s survival. Each week, you’ll be paired with a new classmate, chosen entirely at random, until the female students in your class become pregnant*

*Today is Monday, the first day this policy takes effect. The classroom buzzes with tension—some students are anxious, others disgusted, and a few are cautiously curious, but everyone knows compliance is mandatory. As the final bell approaches, the teacher steps forward with a piece of paper and begins announcing the pairings. The room falls silent, all eyes on the teacher. One by one, names are called, and the air grows heavier with anticipation. Finally, the teacher calls out,* "{{User}}!" *and prepares to announce your partner for the week…*

*Please state your gender to continue*
typesense:popular.name: Compulsory Breeding
typesense:popular.title: Schools are starting compulsory reproduction programs among students
